params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate - Heart of the Half-Beast:}} {{ci|Sett}} {{sti|health regeneration|regenerates}} additional health based on {{as|his '''missing''' health}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate - Heavy Hands:}} '''Sett's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} alternate between his {{as|Left Punch|armor}} and a {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}}. His {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}} attacks more quickly with {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} and deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate - Heart of the Half-Beast:}} '''Sett''' {{as|{{sti|health regeneration|regenerates}}}}{{ft|an additional {{as|{{pp|0.075;0.25;0.5;1;1.025;1.05|1 to 16 for 4;19;20|changedisplay=true|round=3}} health}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds per {{sti|{{as|5% of his '''missing''' health}}}}.|up-to an additional {{as|{{pp|0.075*20;0.25*20;0.5*20;1*20;1.025*20;1.05*20|1 to 16 for 4;19;20|changedisplay=true|round=3}} health}} per {{fd|0.5}} seconds, with the maximum approached as he nears {{sti|{{as|100% '''missing''' health}}}}.}}
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Heavy Hands:}} '''Sett's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} alternate between his {{as|Left Punch|armor}} and a {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}} {{tip|on-attack}}. '''Sett''' begins attacking with his {{as|Left Punch|armor}}, and will reset back to it after 2 seconds of not performing a {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}}.
params.description3: '''Sett's''' {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}} is empowered to gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} (unless ''{{ai|Knuckle Down|Sett}}'' is active), attack at 8 times the {{as|Left Punch's|armor}} {{as|attack speed}}, and deal {{as|{{pp|5 + (90-5)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 55% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
params.notes:
* Alternatively, ''Pit Grit'' grants '''Sett''' {{as|{{pp|0.075*10;0.25*10;0.5*10;1*10;1.025*10;1.05*10|1 to 16 for 4; 19; 20|round=3|changedisplay=true}} '''bonus''' health regeneration}} for every {{as|5% '''missing''' health}}, up to {{as|{{pp|0.075*10*20;0.25*10*20;0.5*10*20;1*10*20;1.025*10*20;1.05*10*20|1 to 16 for 4;19;20|round=3|changedisplay=true}}|hp}} at the theoretical maximum of {{as|100% '''missing''' health}}.
** The bonus regeneration is gained smoothly with the missing health fraction of '''Sett's''' health bar; that means there are no discrete changes in the regeneration at each {{as|5% '''missing''' health}} threshold. The 5% figure is merely in the tooltip as a guideline for the player's quantitative understanding of the effect.
* The {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}} does not grant {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, rather its windup is sped up and fixed at {{ft|{{fd|12.5%}} of a {{as|Left Punch's|armor}} windup time.|800% of a {{as|Left Punch's|armor}} windup speed.}}
** The windup is still affected by {{tip|cripple|cripples}} and attack speed buffs that were not already active for the previous {{as|Left Punch's|armor}}.
* The bonus physical damage from the {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}} benefits from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.

blurb.plain: Innate - Heart of the Half-Beast: Sett regenerates additional health based on his missing health.

blurb2.plain: Innate - Heavy Hands: Sett's basic attacks alternate between his Left Punch and a Right Punch. His Right Punch attacks more quickly with bonus range and deals bonus physical damage.

description.plain: Innate - Heart of the Half-Beast: Sett regenerates an additional 0.075 / 0.25 / 0.5 / 1 / 1.025 / 1.05 (based on level) health every 0.5 seconds per 5% of his missing health.

description2.plain: Innate - Heavy Hands: Sett's basic attacks alternate between his Left Punch and a Right Punch on-attack. Sett begins attacking with his Left Punch, and will reset back to it after 2 seconds of not performing a Right Punch.

description3.plain: Sett's Right Punch is empowered to gain 50 bonus range (unless Knuckle Down is active), attack at 8 times the Left Punch's attack speed, and deal 5 – 100 (based on level) (+ 55% bonus AD) bonus physical damage.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Sett}} empowers his next two basic attacks within a few seconds to gain {{sti|'''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
params.blurb2: He also briefly gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while moving toward enemy {{tip|champions}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sett''' empowers his next two basic attacks within 5 seconds to gain {{sti|50 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, capped at 400 '''total''' damage of each attack against {{tip|monsters}}.
params.leveling: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|10 to 50}} {{as|(+ 1% {{as|(+ {{ap|1 to 3}}% per 100 AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Total Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|10*2 to 50*2}} {{as|(+ 2% {{as|(+ {{ap|1*2 to 3*2}}% per 100 AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
params.description2: For {{fd|1.5}} seconds, '''Sett''' also gains {{sti|movement speed|{{as|30% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champions}} within 2000 units.
params.description3: ''Knuckle Down {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Sett's''' basic attack timer. The empowered attacks are guaranteed to be a {{as|Left Punch|Armor}} followed by a {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}}, resetting '''Sett's''' current {{ai|Pit Grit|Sett}} state (if applicable) and ignoring the usual time-out period for a follow-up {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}}.''
params.notes:
* The bonus movement speed buff is named ''Looking For a Fight''.
* ''Knuckle Down'' can be {{tip|dodged}}, {{tip|blocked}} or missed while '''Sett''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.

blurb.plain: Active: Sett empowers his next two basic attacks within a few seconds to gain bonus range and deal bonus physical damage based on the target's maximum health.

blurb2.plain: He also briefly gains bonus movement speed while moving toward enemy champions.

description.plain: Active: Sett empowers his next two basic attacks within 5 seconds to gain 50 bonus range and deal bonus physical damage, capped at 400 total damage of each attack against monsters.

description2.plain: For 1.5 seconds, Sett also gains 30% bonus movement speed while facing visible enemy champions within 2000 units.

description3.plain: Knuckle Down resets Sett's basic attack timer. The empowered attacks are guaranteed to be a Left Punch followed by a Right Punch, resetting Sett's current Pit Grit state (if applicable) and ignoring the usual time-out period for a follow-up Right Punch.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Sett}} stores ''Grit'' equal to damage taken, which gradually expires after a few seconds.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sett''' converts his current ''Grit'' into a {{tip|shield}} that decays over a short time. He also unleashes a blast in an area in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit based on his expended ''Grit''. Enemies hit in the middle are dealt {{as|true damage}} instead.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Sett''' stores 100% of {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after resistances and modifiers.}} taken as ''Grit'' on his resource bar, up to a cap of {{as|50% of his '''maximum''' health}}. Each instance of stored ''Grit'' decays in value by 30% every second after 4 seconds.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sett''' charges up a strike over the cast time. Additionally, he immediately consumes all of his stored ''Grit'' to grant himself a {{tip|shield}} at the start of the cast time that is equal to the expended ''Grit'' for 3 seconds, decaying in strength over the duration after {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
params.description3: After the cast time, he unleashes a massive blast in an area in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit; those hit in a line in the middle are dealt {{ccs|{{sti|{{as|true damage}}}}|true}} instead.
params.range: {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|-25 – 720|Trapezoid (and inner rectangle) length, starts behind Sett; 745 total length}}
params.width: {{dv|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|300|Trapezoid smaller base, close to Sett}} |{{tt|620|Trapezoid larger base, farther from Sett}}|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|70|Inner true damage rectangle width}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Haymaker's'' total hitbox uses the intersection of a trapezoid and a circle. Enemies are hit by ''Haymaker'' only when their hitbox overlaps with both of those areas.
** {{pending for test}} Where is the center of the circle?
* The trapezoid and the rectangle both register the edge of enemies' {{tip|gameplay radius|hitbox}}.
* The shield is granted at the start of the cast time and will decay afterwards.
* '''Sett''' does not store ''Grit'' from damage that was mitigated by {{tip|shield|shields}}.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* '''Sett''' will turn towards the target direction at the start of the cast time.
* '''Sett''' will glow when attaining 90% ''Grit''. Casting ''Haymaker'' at this amount has a different visual and audio effect.
[[File:90%_Grit_Sett.png|thumb|left|'''Sett''' will turn {{color|#FFDF00|'''golden'''}} ''(base skin)''.]]

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Sett}} {{tip|suppression|carries}} the target enemy {{tip|champion}} and {{tip|dash|dashes}} through the air with {{tip|displacement immunity}}, then slams them into the ground to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies based on the {{as|target's '''bonus''' health}}. Enemies hit are also briefly {{tip|slow|slowed}}.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{tip|displacement immunity|nolink=true}}:}} The dash cannot be deterred by {{tip|crowd control}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sett''' {{tip|suppression|suppresses}} and {{tip|true sight|reveals}} the target enemy {{tip|champion}} while {{tip|dash|dashing}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to their location and {{tip|attach|attaching}} them to himself upon arrival. He leaps another 600 units in the same direction to slam the target into the ground, creating a massive shockwave and quickly {{tip|dash|sliding}} forward 250 units beyond the impact.
params.description2: Enemies within {{tt|the epicenter|125 unit radius around the target's landing location, but not the true center of the area of effect}} take {{ccs|{{as|physical damage}}|physical}}, and other enemies hit by the shockwave take {{as|physical damage}} that is reduced by up to 75% based on proximity. All targets hit are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 99% for 1 second.
params.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|200 to 400}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40 to 60}}% of primary target's '''bonus''' health)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|200*0.25 to 400*0.25}} {{as|(+ 30% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*0.25 to 60*0.25}}% of primary target's '''bonus''' health)}}}}
params.description3: ''The leap will end and create the impact prematurely upon encountering terrain that cannot be dashed through, whether by distance or invalid space.''
params.effect radius: {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|600|From Sett's own final landing destination (may be a bug)}}
params.notes:
* ''The Show Stopper's'' attachment depends on the {{tip|suppression}}; if the target does not remain suppressed by the end of the dash, they are not attached to '''Sett''' when he arrives to them. Similarly, if the suppression is removed, so is the attachment.
** '''Sett''' will still dash to the target and leap forward from them to trigger the shockwave afterwards even if he fails to attach the target to him.
** If the target resists the suppression by being {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}}, {{tip|displacement immune}}, or having a {{tip|spell shield}}, '''Sett''' will not attach them to himself.
** If the target removes the suppression by any means, including with an applicable {{tip|cleanse}} effect or {{tip|dispel}}, they will instantly detach themselves from '''Sett'''.
*** Neither his dash nor leap are interrupted in this case.
* '''Sett's''' slide dash after completing the leap dash cannot pass through terrain.
* '''Sett''' is {{tip|displacement immune}} during both the initial dash and the leap after that dash, as well as for a short duration during his slide beyond on the impact.
* The target is {{tip|true sight|revealed}} specifically while they are suppressed.
* If the target is {{tip|untargetable}} when '''Sett''' completes their dash to them, ''The Show Stopper'' will be cancelled immediately.
** In this case, '''Sett''' will not leap forward nor attach to the target to himself and the suppression is removed from the target.
* If the target moves 2000 units or more away from their location at the time of ''The Show Stopper's'' cast before '''Sett''' completes their dash to them, '''Sett''' will fail to attach the target to him.
** The target will remain suppressed for 5 seconds if this occurs.{{bug}}
* ''The Show Stopper'' will be cancelled if either '''Sett's''' dash or leap is cancelled during the ability by any means.
** The former causes '''Sett''' to not leap forward nor attach to the target to himself and the suppression to be removed from the target.
** The latter causes '''Sett''' to detach the target from himself instantly and the suppression to be removed from the target.
* ''The Show Stopper'' will not be cancelled if the target dies or enters {{tip|resurrection}} during the effect.
* At maximum cast range and if the dash is not shortened due to terrain in '''Sett's''' way, ''The Show Stopper's'' movement takes {{fd|1.5}} seconds, causing the slam {{tt|within {{fd|1.23}} seconds.|Estimated}}
* If '''Sett''' enters {{tip|resurrection}} right before completing his initial dash, he will still leap forward from the target.{{bug}}
* The "crater" VFX originates from the target's landing, which inaccurately illustrates the damage's area of effect (from Sett).{{bug|2}}

blurb.plain: Active: Sett carries the target enemy champion and dashes through the air with displacement immunity, then slams them into the ground to deal physical damage to nearby enemies based on the target's bonus health. Enemies hit are also briefly slowed.

blurb4.plain: displacement immunity: The dash cannot be deterred by crowd control.

description.plain: Active: Sett suppresses and reveals the target enemy champion while dashing with displacement immunity to their location and attaching them to himself upon arrival. He leaps another 600 units in the same direction to slam the target into the ground, creating a massive shockwave and quickly sliding forward 250 units beyond the impact.

description2.plain: Enemies within the epicenter take physical damage, and other enemies hit by the shockwave take physical damage that is reduced by up to 75% based on proximity. All targets hit are slowed by 99% for 1 second.

description3.plain: The leap will end and create the impact prematurely upon encountering terrain that cannot be dashed through, whether by distance or invalid space.
